David Miller.name: David Miller
David Miller.title: The Undisputed World #1 Chase Finisher
David Miller.why_top10: David Miller is the gold standard of high-pressure run chasing. In steep chases where the Required Run Rate exceeds 10.0 RPO, Miller generated an unprecedented +42.27 Counter-Attack WPA — highest in global T20 cricket. He delivered 8 Authentic Match-Winning Pressure Performances (MWPPs), carried 15 high-leverage team wins, and added +17.65 Death Finishing WPA. With zero flaw deductions, his 80.2 clutch rating stands uncontested at World #1.
David Miller.signature_matches: vs CSK (IPL Qualifier: 68* off 38b, WPA +3.45); vs RR (IPL Final: 32* off 19b, WPA +2.18); vs India (T20I: 106* off 47b, WPA +4.10)
